Granblue Fantasy nPake NATIVE

Granblue Fantasy in its own window, with a handy sidebar and a built-in wiki. Smoother, lighter and more convenient than playing in a web browser. The game itself is never changed.

Better than a browser tab

  • Runs lighter. A browser loads Granblue's PC version. This app uses the phone version by default, which is simpler and easier on your computer.
  • No reloading when you resize. Resize or snap the window and the game stays exactly where it was.
  • Everything in one place. Shortcuts, the wiki and a second game view sit right beside the game, with no tabs to juggle.
  • Just the game. No address bar, tabs or browser clutter.

Features

  • Sidebar shortcuts jump straight to Home, Quests, Raids, Party and more. The one you're on lights up.
  • Back and Reload buttons for the game, under the shortcuts.
  • Game size: pick Large or Small in the sidebar.
  • Built-in wiki. Look things up without leaving the game. It remembers the page you were on.
  • Second view. Open a second Granblue beside the first, in the same window, with its own Back and Reload.
  • Extra windows (Options). Open another full window if you need one. Off by default.
  • Three colour themes for the app: Midnight, Ember and Tide.
  • Hide the sidebar any time with the button at its top, or Alt+\.
  • System tray icon (Options), off by default.

Good to know

  • Drag to scroll. Click and drag to scroll the game or the sidebar.
  • Phone or PC version. Options lets you switch to Granblue's PC version instead. The app restarts when you switch.
  • Something wrong? The bottom of Options shows which build you have. Include it when reporting a problem.
  • Your game is safe. This app never changes Granblue, its settings, or your account.

Made by

Koine (AIxIOU on GitHub), a Granblue Fantasy player who wanted a better way to play on PC.

Project page: github.com/AIxIOU/Granblue-Fantasy-Pake

Built on Pake by tw93, an open-source tool for turning websites into desktop apps. Granblue Fantasy is made by Cygames; this is a fan-made app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Cygames.

Technical details

  • Architecture: Tauri v2 on WebView2. Game, sidebar, wiki and a shared About/Options panel are separate webviews in one window on one shared browser environment; nothing is injected into Granblue's document.
  • Client: mobile sends a phone User-Agent with the page request only — a version Cygames already serves. Fixed width, no re-fit on resize. The PC client offers Granblue's own Window Size settings and Layout / Lock; with Automatic Resizing on, the sidebar and panels are hidden.
  • Performance: one shared WebView2 environment for every webview, not one per view. Battle animation is paced at 30 fps by Granblue on both clients.
  • Panels: placed right of the sidebar or between game and sidebar (Options). The wiki is hidden, not destroyed. Second view shares the panel slot with the wiki and opens Large or Small (Options). Extra windows: Off, one extra, or unlimited; each costs about four second views.
  • Locked mode (PC client) hides the chat column with CSS display only.
  • Build stamp: version, build number (commit count), commit hash and build time. Bottom debugger in Options shows diagnostics.
  • Platforms: Windows tested; macOS and Linux untested.
